2025-05-13.riddle: I break but never bleed or cry, I spill my guts when dropped nearby. I’m fragile, round, and found in kitchens— What am I?
2025-05-13.hint: I am often eaten for breakfast.

2025-05-14.riddle: I stretch from wall to glowing wall, You flip a switch—I light it all. I brighten rooms and chase out night— What am I?
2025-05-14.hint: This small object lights up when powered and is often found in lamps or ceilings.

2025-05-15.riddle: What word is spelled incorrectly in every dictionary?
2025-05-15.hint: Sometimes, the answer is hiding right in front of you… literally.

2025-05-16.riddle: I hang on walls to show the day, With boxes neat in full display. You flip my page when months go by— What am I?
2025-05-16.hint: You check me to see the date, plan events, or count down the days. I'm usually on a wall or a desk.

2025-05-17.riddle: I snap a shot but have no hands, I see the world in distant lands. I save your smiles, freeze your face— What am I?
2025-05-17.hint: It captures moments in still images or video, often used on vacations or at celebrations.

2025-05-18.riddle: I go up high with strings attached, In sky-blue games, I’m often matched. The wind’s my friend, I love to glide— What am I?
2025-05-18.hint: It dances in the wind, often flown by kids in open fields or on beaches, attached to a string held from below.

2025-05-19.riddle: I wake you up with beeps or bells, I keep you on time, as stories tell. You set me nightly near your bed— What am I?
2025-05-19.hint: It sits by your bedside and makes noise when it’s time to get up—especially early in the morning.

2025-05-20.riddle: I go in your mouth but I’m not food, I help your teeth, I’m dentist-approved. With bristles bright, I scrub away— What am I?
2025-05-20.hint: It’s something you use every morning and night to keep your smile clean—just add toothpaste and scrub.

2025-05-21.riddle: I see galaxies without eyes. I peer through darkness, chart the skies. With glass and tube, I bring you near To distant worlds both far and clear.
2025-05-21.hint: I’m used by stargazers and scientists alike to explore what’s far beyond our reach.

2025-05-22.riddle: I hold your money, cards, and more, I fold up neatly, small in store. You carry me in purse or jean— What am I?
2025-05-22.hint: It’s small, folds in half, and keeps your cash and cards safe in your pocket or bag.

2025-05-23.riddle: I live in schools but I don’t learn, I swim in tanks and twist and turn. With fins and scales, I dart with glee— What am I?
2025-05-23.hint: It swims in water, lives in tanks or oceans, and is often a pet with fins and gills.

2025-05-24.riddle: I carry books, I zip up tight, I’m on your shoulders day and night. To school and back, I always ride— What am I?
2025-05-24.hint: You wear it on your back, it holds your school supplies, and it usually has zippers and straps.

2025-05-25.riddle: I mark the page so you don’t lose track, I slip right in, then I come back. I’m flat and thin and love to read— What am I?
2025-05-25.hint: I help you find your place in a book without folding any pages.

2025-05-26.riddle: I help you see both near and far, I’m worn by many, no matter who you are. Perched on noses, clear as day— What am I?
2025-05-26.hint: I rest on your nose and help your eyes focus, whether you’re reading a book or watching the horizon.

2025-05-27.riddle: I hold your food when you sit down, I’m round or square, in white or brown. You’ll find me set before you eat— What am I?
2025-05-27.hint: I'm found on tables before meals, holding everything from soup to steak—flat, sturdy, and always ready to serve.
